Ideal Candidate

You are a Sr. Engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, building scalable software, and working across both front-end and back-end technologies. You bring a modern engineering mindset, strong cloud experience, and a passion for improving systems through automation, modernization, and continuous improvement.

Sr. Full Stack Software Engineer (Remote - EST Hours)

Overview

We are seeking two Sr Full Stack Software Engineers to support a highly integrated enterprise technology organization responsible for customer-facing sales, transaction, and platform applications. These are long-term opportunities supporting critical business systems used across a large-scale retail environment.

The ideal candidate will have experience building and supporting enterprise applications using modern front-end and back-end technologies, cloud-native architectures, and DevOps practices. Successful candidates will thrive in a collaborative Agile environment and be comfortable working remotely while supporting Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours.

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

• 5+ years of experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer developing enterprise-scale applications.
• Strong front-end development experience with:
• Angular
• TypeScript
• Strong back-end development experience with:
• Java 17+
• Spring Boot
• Microservices architecture
• Experience developing and supporting highly integrated applications across complex distributed systems.
• Expertise in data transformation, API integrations, and service orchestration.

Cloud & DevOps

• Hands-on experience with:
• Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
• Kubernetes
• CI/CD pipeline automation
• GitHub Actions
• Experience deploying and maintaining cloud-native applications.
• Familiarity with modern DevOps and platform engineering best practices.

Modern Engineering Experience

• Experience working within Agile development environments.
• Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and modern software delivery practices.
• Ability to design and deliver scalable, maintainable enterprise solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

• NestJS
• React
• Platform Engineering
• Advanced DevOps practices
• Agentic AI orchestration
• Multi-region cloud deployments
• Framework modernization initiatives
• Enterprise application migration and technical debt reduction

Depending on team placement, responsibilities may include:

Application Development Team

• Build and enhance enterprise sales, cart, and transaction applications.
• Develop new features using Angular, TypeScript, Java, and Spring Boot.
• Integrate applications with multiple enterprise systems and services.
• Support customer-facing workflows and high-volume transaction processing.
• Participate in application modernization initiatives.

Platform Engineering Team

• Manage and enhance CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
• Develop and maintain GitHub Actions workflows.
• Support Google Cloud Platform deployments and Kubernetes environments.
• Drive framework upgrades, platform modernization, and technical debt reduction efforts.
• Improve deployment reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

What You'll Be Working On

• Enterprise-scale customer and transaction systems
• Cloud-native application architectures
• Automated deployment and release management
• Platform modernization initiatives
• AI-assisted software development practices
• Large-scale integrations across multiple business systems

What We Offer

• 100% Remote work environment
• Long-term engagement supporting critical enterprise platforms
• Exposure to large-scale cloud-native architectures
• Opportunity to work with Angular, Java, Spring Boot, GCP, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions
• Highly collaborative Agile teams
• Opportunity to influence modernization and engineering best practices

Work Environment

• Fully Remote

This is a Contract position based out of Atlanta, GA.
